_comment: USD per 1M tokens (input=prompt, output=completion). Verified 2026-05-14 against ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing and openrouter.ai/google/* model pages. Update when providers change pricing. Lookup keys: 'provider:model' (preferred) or 'model' (fallback).
_caveat_2_5_pro: gemini-2.5-pro uses context-window-tier pricing: ≤200K input $1.25/output $10, >200K input $2.50/output $15. Our prices.py models a single (prompt, completion) pair, so cost is UNDERESTIMATED for prompts above 200K tokens. Acceptable for our usage (config_generate prompts are <50K).
_comment_legacy: gemini 1.5 변종은 OpenRouter 에서 retired 됐을 가능성. :free 만 유효한 별칭으로 남아있을 수 있음. 확인 후 사용.
